observed.caption: A panoramic daytime view of a crowded urban park with trees, pavilions and a pond in the foreground and a dense city skyline with tall buildings under a partly cloudy sky in the background.
observed.description: The image shows a wide panoramic outdoor view with a grassy urban park in the foreground containing scattered green trees, open grassy areas, a small reflective pond on the center-right, and several long covered pavilions with metal roofs near clusters of parked light-colored vehicles. A large crowd of small distant figures is spread across the grass sitting and standing in groups. Behind the park, a dense skyline of numerous high-rise buildings of varying heights, shapes and colors stretches across the horizon, including a prominent yellow-brown twin-tower building with an antenna on the left-center and a tall narrow cylindrical tower on the right. The sky above is blue with scattered white cumulus clouds and the lighting is bright daylight.
